mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing a comfortable 75 degrees with clear skies near the Verona Area High School, and we will be enjoying a beautiful Full Moon tonight.

The city is currently reviewing several proposals for the upcoming November 4 Plan Commission meeting, including final plats for Ardent Glen and site plans for 1979 Milky Way, while the Finance Department reminds residents that tax bills will arrive by December 15.
There is a lot happening in our community, including live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Lake Lou-ee today, followed by yoga classes at Insight Wellness tomorrow.
The Verona Police Department reported an incident from October 15 where officers arrested a school bus driver for O W I after responding to reports of dangerous driving behavior.
Today's flavor of the day is the delightful Snickers Swirl, and since the restaurant is currently open, you have plenty of time to head over before they close at 10 PM tonight.
